verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device inference engine, so KV-cache memory management is a fair axis for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions paged attention, KV-cache paging, fragmentation handling, or concurrent request capacity. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.
